title: The operator's decision a call carries in _meta.decision (fabric-actions/0.1, DEC-0121 AP-2)
description: The operator's decision on one relayed action, carried by a T0 or T1 caller in its request's _meta.decision, or in a hub agent.call's or sealed call's call.decision (DEC-0121 AP-2). An agent sets it only for the operator's own words, from the sources and in the form AP-3 names (docs/specification/service.md#actions); an elicitation the person accepted is the service's own record, never this. action is the declared action's id and must be the called one; target, when present, the one object the operator named, which the service compares with the call's. A service reads at strictly (src/rfc3339.ts strictTime) and refuses decision-invalid a decision more than 60 s after its clock or more than 24 h before it.

action.description: The id of the action this decision is for: a declared action's (extensions/actions/0.1), or a job input request's key (C3.3).

target.description: The one object the operator named (a review, a draft, a job), as the service identifies it; the service refuses decision-invalid when the call acts on another.

instruction.description: The operator's sentence that names this action, verbatim; or, for a confirmation, the agent's question that names the action and the operator's answer, both verbatim (AP-3).

source.description: Where the operator said the words, when they reached the deciding agent from another of the operator's agents (DEC-0126 OA-2); the service records it with the decision. Absent: the agent heard them itself (AP-3).
